# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 12 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 3 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--fg);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the dark value */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fg` | #e8f2f7 | Titles and primary text on bg. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */

/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the dark value */
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bg` | #07090c | Page background of every surface. Never grey, never white. |
| `dim` | #8fa3b0 | The line under a title, secondary text. |
| `faint` | #5a6b78 | Chevrons, section labels, version line. Not for body text (3.5:1). |
| `line` | #1b2430 | Dividers. |
| `accent` | #7dd3fc | Ice blue: what is active (tab, link, action pill). |
| `violet` | #8b5cf6 | Only for on (toggles) and the ring. |
| `violet-light` | #a78bfa | Hover and edges of violet things. |
| `error` | #f87171 | Destructive only (Delete account). |
| `ok` | #4ade80 | Done. |
| `wait` | #fde68a | Waiting. |
| `glass` | rgba(180, 225, 255, .07) | Fill of every card. |
| `edge` | rgba(190, 230, 255, .14) | 1px stroke of every card. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-hero);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-text);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hero` | `.hero`, `--text-hero` | 34px / 40px | 700 | `display` | Big headline on a hero or post. |
| `page-title` | `.page-title`, `--text-page-title` | 28px / 34px | 700 | `display` | Page title in the app. |
| `row-title` | `.row-title`, `--text-row-title` | 17px / 22px | 400 | `text` | Card and row titles. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 20px | 400 | `text` | Running text (body text). |
| `sub` | `.sub`, `--text-sub` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `text` | The dim line under a title. |
| `tab` | `.tab`, `--text-tab` | 13px / 16px | 400 | `text` | Tab bar labels. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 10.5px / 14px | 500 | `mono` | Section labels, caps, faint. |
| `value` | `.value`, `--text-value` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `mono` | Times, counters. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `--font-text` | `"SF Pro Text", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"SF Pro Display", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace` |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`) and upload it as an asset where you use it (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url the upload returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `fonts/<id>` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SF Pro Text | `fonts/SF-Pro-Text-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file | `var(--font-text)` | `sf-pro-text` |
| SF Pro Display | `fonts/SF-Pro-Display-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file | `var(--font-display)` | `sf-pro-display` |
| SF Mono | `fonts/SF-Mono-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file | `var(--font-mono)` | `sf-mono` |

Every face: `fonts/SF-Pro-Text-Regular.woff2` (SF Pro Text, 400), `fonts/SF-Pro-Text-Medium.woff2` (SF Pro Text, 500), `fonts/SF-Pro-Text-Semibold.woff2` (SF Pro Text, 600), `fonts/SF-Pro-Text-Bold.woff2` (SF Pro Text, 700), `fonts/SF-Pro-Display-Regular.woff2` (SF Pro Display, 400), `fonts/SF-Pro-Display-Semibold.woff2` (SF Pro Display, 600), `fonts/SF-Pro-Display-Bold.woff2` (SF Pro Display, 700), `fonts/SF-Mono-Regular.woff2` (SF Mono, 400), `fonts/SF-Mono-Medium.woff2` (SF Mono, 500), `fonts/SF-Mono-Semibold.woff2` (SF Mono, 600).

## Spacing


### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pad-card` | 14px | Padding inside a card. |

| `gutter` | 16px | Page side margin. |
